question: A characteristic component of murein or peptidoglycan in most bacterial species is:
analysis: Murein or peptidoglycan is a major component of the cell wall in most bacterial species. It is composed of alternating N-acetylglucosamine (NAG) and N-acetylmuramic acid (NAM) residues cross-linked by short peptides. The D-alanine is a characteristic component of the peptide side chains in peptidoglycan.
